_about: The pictures of the mini-gallery (television: Your selection; standard module: the gallery in the header). key = the id of the topic whose button opens it ('comfort') or of one of its parts ('adaptation/adjustable'); a part's picture wins over its topic's. cut = a clean cut-out on a transparent background (it floats on the card, with a soft shadow); a picture without cut is a designed picture and is shown whole, with rounded corners: a picture is cut only when the cut is flawless, otherwise it stays whole. There is never a field behind a picture. File names are content-addressed on media.divinedunlop.com/ddtv/.
